messages:
anya: Heads-up: I ran into a client that ignored intermediate rollout pins during a zipper ramp. Do we want an explicit phase field in rollout metadata so SDKs can decide how to behave?

devon: We should. Current anchor-only semantics are simple but zipper/canary flows are becoming common. Two worries: (1) adding enums that will churn, (2) older clients breaking.

kai: Proposal: small stable surface: `phase_type` ("zipper" | "canary" | "steady"), `phase_index` (int), `phase_ttl_seconds`. Clients that don't understand `phase_type` just use `anchor_version`.

zara: Another useful field: `phase_mode` = "observe" | "force". `observe` means clients should not persist local pins, only probe. `force` means clients may pin locally to reduce latency. This avoids accidental local cache locking during probe-only windows.

anya: Good call on mode. Also want `ordered_aliases` boolean so server can say whether alias order defines priority. Avoid relying solely on array position.

devon: Ops note: `phase_ttl_seconds` interacts badly with aggressive client polls. Suggest server enforce a minimum TTL (300s) and recommend exponential backoff in SDKs. Add `server_min_ttl` to docs.

kai: For forward-compatibility, include `compatibility_level` string (e.g., "v1", "v2"). Old SDKs see v1 and ignore phases; new SDKs read additional fields. This lets us evolve without breaking.

zara: Draft minimal schema (example):
```
anchor_version: "model-2026-03-22-xyz"
ordered_aliases: true
phase_type: "zipper"
phase_index: 1
phase_ttl_seconds: 600
phase_mode: "observe"
lease_token: "lt_ab12cd"
origin: "rollout-job-99"
compatibility_level: "v2"
```

anya: Telemetry: `phase_transition_reason` (manual/auto/metric), `safety_token` to correlate unexpected evictions, and optional `client_ack` enum to mark whether the client applied the pin.

devon: Fallback rules (must include in RFC): servers must always include a valid `anchor_version`. If client cannot parse `phase_type` or `phase_mode`, it must fall back to anchor-only semantics. No client should be forced to parse new fields.

kai: Edgecase: chained rollouts where two zippers overlap. Recommend `origin` and `rollout_id` and that `phase_index` be monotonic per `rollout_id`. Also allow multiple concurrent rollouts by name but document priority heuristics.

zara: Migration/playbook: (1) servers add new fields but preserve anchor-only behavior, (2) rollout jobs default to `observe` for first two phases, (3) monitor `client_ack` mismatch and only promote to `force` after <1% mismatch.

ops-bot: Deploy note: rollout 99 started 3999998900. Plan: zipper phases every 15m, server-min-ttl=300s, alert on >3% client ack mismatch or >2x cache miss.

anya: I'll open RFC follow-up with schema, examples, and migration checklist. Tagging @devon @kai for early review :thumbsup:
